title: From Ping-Pong to Kidnapping: How ‘Marty Supreme’ and ‘Dead Man’s Wire’ Show Two Men Driven to Extremes
summary: Josh Safdie opens up about the challenges of making his table-tennis movie starring Timothée Chalamet, while Gus Van Sant dives into the real-world parallels of his film featuring Bill Skarsgard as a man who feels that he's been screwed by his mortgage company and abducts the son of the company's CEO.
